summary: Raised PHASE2_VAL_SIM_INTERVAL from 1 to 3 (audit finding #10 fix). Updated config.py comment with rationale (val window is fixed post task-1, cache is chromosome-keyed, skipping val on gens 2/3 cuts GPU work ~33%). Verified val cache is chromosome-keyed (not gen-keyed) in evox_runner.py:_inherit_val_metrics_from_global_cache — no code change needed. Fixed existing test assertions in test_phase2_val_sim_interval.py that were structurally impossible (val < train never held due to cache keeping train calls on gen 0 only while val refresh calls span multiple gens). Replaced fragile count comparisons with generation-tracking assertions using the generation kwarg now captured by CountingEngine. Added 3 new tests: (1) direct unit test of _should_run_val_this_gen with interval=3, (2) integration test verifying val runs on gens 0,3,6,9,12 for a 13-gen epoch, (3) integration test verifying val runs on gens 0,3,4 for a 5-gen epoch (deterministic caching). All existing tests continue to pass.
